title.zh: 将伊莎贝拉省Roxas市镇Basilio村的名称正式变更为San Jose的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Basilio in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Isabela, to San Jose
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Barrio of Basilio in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Isabela, to San Jose
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Barrio Basilio tại Thị trấn Roxas, Tỉnh Isabela thành San Jose
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อบารริโอ Basilio ในเทศบาล Roxas, จังหวัด Isabela เป็น San Jose
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Barrio Basilio di Kotamadya Roxas, Provinsi Isabela menjadi San Jose
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Barrio Basilio di Perbandaran Roxas, Wilayah Isabela menjadi San Jose

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2097_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the barrio of Basilio in the Municipality of Roxas, Province of Isabela, is hereby changed to San Jose.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 22, 1959.
